Title: The Life of Will Rogers—Part 2
Content: Rogers continued performing as a trick roper even after he returned to the United
States. For nearly `text(ten years)`, he traveled with the Wirth Brothers Circus. Then, in
`text(1915)`, he received a lucky offer. Legendary showman Florenz Ziegfeld asked
Rogers to appear in `text(one)` of his stage shows. The show was called the Ziegfeld
Follies. The appearance was supposed to last only `text(one week)`, but Rogers was a big
hit with the crowds. `ultext(Ziegfeld asked him to stay with the show, he continued)`
`ultext(performing in the follies. Rogers performed in the follies for several months.)`
Rogers did excellent rope tricks, but he was more popular for his humor than his
roping. Rogers realized that performing in the follies was different from doing
tricks for the circus. The circus traveled from town to town. Even when it played
the same town for several `ultext(days different)` people watched the shows. This meant
Rogers could perform it over and over again.
